name: Sortilèges Saint-Denis
notes: 21 rue de la Compagnie · 02 62 51 14 67. Online shop with prices (no stock shown); order online and collect, or reserve by phone or Facebook. Runs Pokémon tournaments from time to time.

name: Sortilèges Saint-Pierre
notes: 43 rue du Four à Chaux · 02 62 27 46 49. Same online shop as Saint-Denis. Its website gives two different sets of opening hours, so check before going.

name: Miyata Kard Market
notes: 56 rue Sarda Garriga · 0692 60 58 18 · Tue–Sat 13:00–18:00. The only local site that shows in-stock / sold-out status, and it posts release dates.

name: Planet Geek
notes: 69 A rue François de Mahy · 0693 99 90 03. Online prices and pre-orders (marked PRÉCO, with deadlines). Runs its own league.

name: PUNK Records
notes: 76 rue Roland Garros · 0693 00 31 81 · Tue–Sat 13:00–21:00. Official Bandai TCG+ shop with regular One Piece tournaments. Click & collect.

name: Mirage Island 974
notes: Online only, with Pokémon pre-orders and a new-arrivals section. Game nights are announced on Facebook.

name: Popmarket
notes: Couldn't find it online yet. Send its Facebook or Instagram page and it will be added properly.

name: Toy shops and hypermarkets
notes: Stores here couldn't be confirmed online (JouéClub/Starjouet, Leclerc, Carrefour). Pokémon boosters often turn up in toy aisles; tell me which ones you visit and they can be added.

name: Adilsons
notes: Prices in rupees with stock status online. The Pokémon range is mostly merchandise; Japanese One Piece boosters appear at times.

name: Ubuy Mauritius
notes: Imports to Mauritius. Usually expensive; useful for checking whether something can be found at all.

name: Cardmarket
notes: Europe's main card marketplace. Not yet confirmed whether you can sign up from Réunion or Mauritius, and each seller picks the countries they ship to.

name: eBay
notes: Each listing says whether it ships to you. Forwarding services exist for Réunion buyers.

name: Customs: parcels to Réunion
notes: Parcels from mainland France or the EU count as imports to Réunion, and can be charged VAT, octroi de mer and La Poste handling fees (€2 per item from 1 Nov 2026). Buying in shops on the island avoids this.

name: Customs: bringing cards home to Mauritius
notes: Personal items up to Rs 1,000 are allowed; above that, duty and 15% VAT apply. The exact duty on trading cards is unconfirmed. Keep receipts.
